title: Secondhand shopping is going mainstream this holiday season as consumers seek value
summary: This holiday season, there is a noticeable shift towards secondhand shopping as consumers prioritize value and distinctiveness in their purchases. The trend reflects a growing awareness of sustainability and a desire to find unique gifts that stand out from mass-produced items. As more individuals embrace this approach, the secondhand market is becoming increasingly mainstream, offering a viable alternative to traditional retail options.
